title: Planet Lab — Space, at your pace
description: An original dark, editorial-style planetary playground with eight procedurally textured worlds, a glowing Sun, orbit paths, selectable field notes, close-up camera tracking, responsive controls, and a readable WebGL fallback.

tests.name: JavaScript syntax
tests.details: Node accepted the ES module without syntax errors.

tests.name: Local Vite bundle, in memory
tests.details: Vite resolved Three.js, OrbitControls, and local CSS and bundled successfully. No bundle files were written.

knownLimitations: Browser localhost access was unavailable; no browser rendering, interaction, mobile-device, or visual checks were performed.
Orbital motion, planet sizes, distances, and generated surface art are intentionally stylized and are labelled as such in the interface.
This is an orbital toy, not a physical simulation or a scientifically accurate ephemeris.
WebGL startup failure or context loss displays a labelled fallback with working planet information; reloading is needed to attempt 3D initialization again.
